mainEntity.name: Do you deliver to Muskoka cottages, including islands?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario. Island and water-access properties need extra planning for transport; we'll discuss options and any added cost before you order.

mainEntity.name: Can I put a sauna near the shoreline?

acceptedAnswer.text: Muskoka municipalities set shoreline setbacks, and these vary by lake and township. We'll help you confirm the allowed distance before choosing a spot.

mainEntity.name: Wood or electric for a cottage?

acceptedAnswer.text: Wood suits cottages without a nearby electrical panel and owners who love a fire. Electric with Wi-Fi control lets you preheat before you arrive. Both work on our larger saunas.

mainEntity.name: How much does delivery and installation cost in Muskoka?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delivery and installation is $1,750 anywhere in Ontario, including Muskoka. Delivery only is $450. HST is shown separately on every quote.

mainEntity.name: What heater size does my sauna need?

acceptedAnswer.text: We size every heater to the sauna's interior volume plus extra for glass. None of our saunas take less than a 6 kW heater; larger models use 9 to 10.5 kW electric or a wood stove where there's room for its clearances.
